clause: Deterministic tiled/ROI re-render + seed reproducibility + reversible effect history [STU-FX-011,STU-FX-011b,STU-FX-012,STU-FX-012b,STU-FX-012c]

scope.summary: Implement deterministic effect evaluation (byte-stable per backend for same source+params+mask+seed+StudioColorProfile), integer seed on random-component kinds (noise/clouds/spatter), tiled progressive region-of-interest re-render that re-evaluates only affected tiles and entries at/above the changed entry (interactive preview is the same RenderEngine pass at reduced quality, never a divergent path), StudioAdjustment nodes interleaving with StudioLiveFilter nodes in ONE stack order, and every effect mutation (apply/update/reorder/toggle/mask-edit/remove/bake) as one reversible StudioHistoryEntry; animatable parameters exposed as sampled fields for the 14.11 StudioMotionTimeline.
acceptance_criteria: deterministic seeded eval; tiled ROI re-render; preview==final; every mutation reversible history entry; adjustment/filter one order
expected_tests: test: same inputs => byte-stable output on fixed backend; seeded noise reproducible
test: editing one entry re-evaluates only affected tiles + entries at/above; preview == committed at reduced quality
live: each effect mutation is one undoable StudioHistoryEntry; undo/redo restores exact prior stack

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Non-deterministic/unbounded effect eval; irreversible edits; preview diverges from output.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
